changed: Auth placement and the live sandbox check now come from the admitted plugins' manifest connection sections instead of server tables keyed by the odoo19 id (R-1, ADR 0012 item 1, ADR 0026). New e_agent.sdk.connection types the section (auth methods with header placement, test_connection probe name). PluginRegistry validates it at admission, before plugin code loads, refusing an unknown placement, method type, key or a missing prefix with STARTUP_REJECTED, and records connection_specs, auth_placements and per-plugin executors. Bootstrap gains admit_plugins(); CredentialService reads the registry's placements by reference and refuses (AuthRequired) an integration that declares no auth method instead of defaulting to 'Authorization: Bearer' (review R-1); _check_sandbox refuses a live provider (an enabled plugin used by a profile connection) whose manifest names no probe, and probes each provider through its own executor. AUTH_PLACEMENT and LIVE_PROVIDERS_WITH_SANDBOX are gone; the Odoo placement (Authorization, 'bearer ') and the Odoo target comparison are unchanged. At the owner's instruction (2026-10-15) the task also commits the owner's .claude/settings.json change: shell commands are pre-approved, the git ask rules and the bash-guard hook are removed, the odoo-bench deny rules stay, and new deny rules block Docker commands that reach every container (docker stop/kill/restart/rm $(...), system/container/volume/network prune). The settings conformance tests, AGENTS.md and the eng-session skill follow.
open_items: AuthContext.apply in sdk/auth.py still carries 'Authorization'/'Bearer ' defaults; they are now unreachable from the host, because every placement the registry records names its header and prefix and CredentialService refuses an undeclared one; removing them is a cleanup outside this contract

The sandbox target comparison (database, company_id, bridge_version, server_version 19.0) is still Odoo-shaped in bootstrap; a manifest-declared expectation map would change the odoo19 manifest digest and is left for the task that re-pins (1d.10/1d.12) or a later ADR
Live check against odoo19-learning not run in this task (level 4 belongs to 1d.12); unit tests cover the probe with a stand-in executor and the real packaged Odoo connection section
check_wheels.py was run by hand on 7d6188e and passed; it is not part of the full gate set

rulings.ruling: A manifest with more than one auth method is refused at admission, because connections carry no auth-method id and choosing one would be a default
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a provider offering several methods cannot be admitted until connections gain a method reference (ADR 0013 admin work); relax the validator then

rulings.ruling: AuthMethod.type is limited to api_key and none, and placement to header, matching what AuthContext.apply implements
rulings.cost_if_wrong: OAuth or query placement providers are refused until their mechanics land (ADR 0013); extend the Literal with the implementation

rulings.ruling: The connection section stays an untyped dict on PluginManifest and is validated at admission, so an installed but not enabled plugin with a bad section never breaks discovery
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a malformed section is noticed only when the plugin is enabled; if discovery-time validation is wanted, type PluginManifest.connection later

rulings.ruling: test_connection must be a public lower-case identifier, since bootstrap calls it with getattr on the plugin's executor
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a provider with a differently named probe must rename it; low

rulings.ruling: The plan's expected red for the second-provider test (KeyError from AUTH_PLACEMENT) did not occur: CredentialService fell back to 'Authorization: Bearer'. The test asserts an X-Api-Key header with an empty prefix, which failed for that reason before the change
rulings.cost_if_wrong: none; the test is stronger than planned

rulings.ruling: Contract scope added src/e_agent/kernel/credentials.py (keep the placement mapping by reference) and bootstrap.admit_plugins() as a test seam; neither is in the plan's file list
rulings.cost_if_wrong: small; the seam can be folded back into build_runtime

rulings.ruling: Review R-1 fixed in this task: CredentialService no longer falls back to api_key for an integration with no declared placement; it raises AuthRequired
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a plugin admitted without auth_methods that expected the old Bearer default now fails at its first credential lookup; it must declare its placement (or type none) in its manifest

rulings.ruling: Review R-2 (an enabled plugin that no connection uses is not probed) accepted as is: nothing can reach such a plugin's executor without a connection of its integration
rulings.cost_if_wrong: if a future path reaches a provider without a connection, the live check must key on plugin kind instead

rulings.ruling: The owner's settings change is committed inside 1d.2 (scope amended) rather than in a separate harness task, so the task could close on a clean tree
rulings.cost_if_wrong: the history mixes a harness-config change into a server task; revert e72e284 to separate it

rulings.ruling: With bash-guard unwired, odoo-bench is protected only by literal deny rules; commands that hide the name (sh -c, eval, xargs, a variable, another docker context) are no longer caught
rulings.cost_if_wrong: an agent command could reach the running bench; re-wire bash-guard in deny-only mode (never asks) if that risk is not acceptable
